chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who closed the door of a house upon a bird from the pigeons of the Haram, and it died, he عليه السلام said: "He should give a dirham in charity, or feed with it the pigeons of the Haram."

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the source of the ruling
key_terms.بِدِرْهَمٍ: With one dirham, the specified amount of compensation
key_terms.حَمَامِ الْحَرَمِ: The pigeons belonging to the sacred sanctuary
key_terms.يَتَصَدَّقُ: He gives in charity as compensation
key_terms.يُطْعِمُ: He feeds, as an alternative form of compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone causes the death of a pigeon of the Haram by confining it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning liability for causing the death of a pigeon belonging to the Haram precinct. It prescribes compensation through charity of one dirham or by feeding the pigeons of the Haram, reflecting the sanctity of the Haram and the protection of its creatures.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2352 - Al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who closed the door of a house on a pigeon from the Haram, causing it to die.
Imam (as) said: "He must give a dirham in charity or use it to feed the pigeons of the Haram."
